contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate, possibly of Carus (282-283), Reece period 14, not found in RIC. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right, tightly curled short beard. Obverse inscription: CARVS [AVG]. Reverse description: Figure standing left with vertical sceptre, hanging cloak and forked object in right hand - ?thunderbolt. Reverse inscription: [-]DVILI [--]. Diameter: 16.8mm, Weight: 2.69gms, die axis: 12
